[[File:MedLabDroid-TCWs2BR3.png|thumb|right|200px|A model of a science droid.]]
A '''science droid''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] utilized multiple science droids aboard the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']], including [[8K6]] and [[8L6]].<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> [[I2-1A]] was a science droid owned by [[Nestin Thokor]], the [[Comptroller]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Oluna Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]].<ref name="No Place Like Home">{{LivingForce|No Place Like Home}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Unidentified science droid model/Legends|type]] of hovering science droid<ref name="Complete Season Two">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]]</ref> was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="ZBSB">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref> and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>
